SELECT ENTRUST_ID as closeId,ps as ps,finprod_type2 as finprodType2, TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,btm.OUTPUT_VALUE_1 busiTypePosition FROM ETR_ENTRUST LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE_CONFIG btm ON ( ETR_ENTRUST.FINPROD_TYPE2 = btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 IS NULL) AND ( ETR_ENTRUST.PS = btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 IS NULL) AND ( ETR_ENTRUST.TRADE_PLAT = btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 IS NULL) WHERE PS != #{PS_T03} AND ENTRUST_ID IN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID FROM ETR_ENTRUST WHERE ENTRUST_STATUS IN ( #{ENTRUST_STATUS_01}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_02}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_03}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_05},#{ENTRUST_STATUS_08},#{ENTRUST_STATUS_07} )
AND MDATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
) UNION ALL SELECT ENTRUST_ID as closeId,ps as ps,finprod_type2 as finprodType2, TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,btm.OUTPUT_VALUE_1 busiTypePosition FROM ETR_ENTRUST EE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE_CONFIG btm ON ( EE.FINPROD_TYPE2 = btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_2 IS NULL) AND ( EE.PS = btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_3 IS NULL) AND ( EE.TRADE_PLAT = btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 OR btm.INPUT_VALUE_1 IS NULL) WHERE EE.PS = 'T03' AND ENTRUST_ID IN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID FROM ETR_ENTRUST WHERE ENTRUST_STATUS IN ( #{ENTRUST_STATUS_01}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_02}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_03}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_05},#{ENTRUST_STATUS_08},#{ENTRUST_STATUS_07} )
AND MDATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
) AND EXISTS ( SELECT RFPD.ENTRUST_ID FROM REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL RFPD INNER JOIN FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN FEP ON RFPD.FINPROD_ID = FEP.FINPROD_ID AND RFPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F01} AND RFPD.PS = #{PS_T03} AND RFPD.TRADE_DATE > FEP.VDATE
AND FEP.EXERCISE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') +1
WHERE EE.ENTRUST_ID = RFPD.ENTRUST_ID)

SELECT ENTRUST_ID FROM ETR_ENTRUST WHERE PS != #{PS_T03} AND ENTRUST_ID IN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID FROM ETR_ENTRUST WHERE ENTRUST_STATUS IN ( #{ENTRUST_STATUS_01}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_02}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_03}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_05},#{ENTRUST_STATUS_08},#{ENTRUST_STATUS_07})
AND MDATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
) UNION ALL SELECT EE.ENTRUST_ID FROM ETR_ENTRUST EE WHERE EE.PS = #{PS_T03} AND EE.ENTRUST_STATUS IN ( #{ENTRUST_STATUS_01}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_02}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_03}, #{ENTRUST_STATUS_05},#{ENTRUST_STATUS_08},#{ENTRUST_STATUS_07}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT RFPD.ENTRUST_ID FROM REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL RFPD INNER JOIN FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN FEP ON RFPD.FINPROD_ID = FEP.FINPROD_ID AND RFPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F01} AND RFPD.PS = #{PS_T03} AND RFPD.TRADE_DATE > FEP.VDATE
AND FEP.EXERCISE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') +1
WHERE EE.ENTRUST_ID = RFPD.ENTRUST_ID)
